assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_SHINSO_HITOSHI_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its SI-SUP-01 to SI-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe SI-V01 are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Shinso from the V03:p113-115 and V04:p118-156 Sports Festival applicant, through the V21:p091-168 joint training with Persona Chords and the V22:p157-180 and V23:p059-066 interruption and admission to further training, the V35:p077-093 trained compelled speech in a coordinated operation and the V38:p133-156 control of Machia and limit on authoring the heart, to the V42:p047 and p163 Class A entry and adult professional continuity. Kept as separable states: stigmatized applicant, trained provisional participant, emergency specialist, admitted and adult hero; later compelled speech is not assigned to the festival version of Brainwashing and V42 admission is not assigned to the applicant. No atom covers V05-V20, V24-V34, V36-V37 or V39-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states persistent priorities (legitimate hero participation, demonstrable competence, useful use of an ability coded as dangerous, SI01-SI04), an ideal self who earns access, a feared self excluded or seen only as a suspect instrument, and the developmental contradiction between service and proving himself (SI03). Six located atoms SI01-SI06 at high confidence; the probe SI-V01 supports motive. Not B: one compact artifact, one retrospective nonblind probe, and private adult breadth is OPEN. Not D: the policy is operational with stated flip conditions.

Four states are named and kept apart with located transitions: festival access attempt (SI01), trainable competence and self-critique (SI02), admission to further training (SI03), trained compelled speech (SI04-SI05) and Class A entry (SI06). The model says grievance intensity is state-dependent and forbids assigning later repertoire to early Shinso. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and SI06 is high confidence for status only. Not D: change is located with explicit state variables.

The model identifies 俺, blunt and economical phrasing, adversarial bait and technically exact limits, distinguishes the elicitation function of provocation (SI03) from honest explanatory assertion (SI05, rechecked in Japanese), and excludes Persona Chords imitation as an affect sample. The probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: no located lines are quoted and adult formal institutional address is less densely sampled. Not E: a recurrent register and its functional variants are identified and tested on one axis. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

The evidence set enacts no ordinary routine of his; the model says ordinary leisure and family predictions should remain low confidence, and the supplement items concern classmates' planning and costume design rather than his conduct. This gap says nothing about the character.

A five-row partner table gives conditional behavior for Aizawa, Midoriya, Ochako, Monoma and teams, and a controlled target. Midoriya changes from early provocation (SI01) to someone he helps interrupt safely (SI03); Aizawa's correction and admission (SI02-SI03), Ochako's emergency direction (SI03) and the controlled target (SI05) are located. Not B: the probe rates relationship handling partial and no broad reciprocal bond is tested. D considered; rejected because several partners have located, state-conditioned deltas.

Self-assessment is located in recalled peer stigma (SI01), self-examination after victory (SI02) and his admission that competition occupied his attention (SI03), but emotional regulation is described in general terms and the probe's emotional trajectory is underdetermined because a short assertion cannot establish the stress response. C rejected for that reason. Not E: several located reflective windows exist.

The decision policy is explicit: create a response condition, use available control within its limits, and integrate equipment and learned movement; flip conditions are stated (no responder, an ally endangered by the tactic, an opponent who understands the trigger). It is located in tactical bait (SI01), team training (SI02), coordinated compelled speech (SI04) and the Machia operation (SI05). The probe supports action narrowly. Not B: one probe on one axis of professional judgment. Not D: the policy is explicit, located and tested.

The model states his practical morality as authorization-, context- and execution-dependent use of coercion (SI04) and locates the limit that controlling behavior does not author a heart (SI05), but no dilemma he weighs is analyzed; the consent and command conditions are constraints the model imposes on a simulation rather than his located deliberation. C rejected for lack of a located weighing. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.
The evidence set establishes no humor or play practice either way. This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements; six atoms span V03-V42 with page locators, and SI05's decisive pages were directly checked. No atom covers V05-V20, V24-V34, V36-V37 or V39-V41, SI06 is thin, and the supplements are profile facts, editorial summaries, design notes and author comments.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs villainous essence and complete mental ownership, forbids telepathy, memory access, omnipotent persuasion and motive rewriting, limits his knowledge of a target to observation, briefing or recordings, states no evidence warrants a globally cynical adult or frictionless post-admission confidence, and records that the classmates' farewell planning was not knowledge he had (SI-SUP-01). Not B: limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

The model names four states, page-locates every atom, forbids assigning V42 admission to the applicant or later compelled speech to the festival Brainwashing, and requires stating which version of Brainwashing applies. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The model states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation, quotes no located lines, and excludes imitated voices as affect samples. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Shinso's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, with the Brainwashing version and repertoire stated; post-V38 reasoning is not given to the festival applicant.
The interlocutor is Aizawa, Midoriya, Ochako, a training or operation teammate, or a controlled target, handled as the partner table gives; no invented private relationship.
Brainwashing requires a response, gives no telepathy, memory access or motive rewriting, and his knowledge of a target comes only from observation, briefing or recordings.

Output is a behavioral description with high-confidence behavior, plausible alternatives and flip conditions, abstaining on private adult breadth; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: festival applicant, trained provisional participant after V21-V23, or emergency specialist after V35-V38, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Aizawa as exacting sponsor, Midoriya, Ochako, teammates or a controlled target, in the relation the partner table gives.
setting_constraints: Training, competition or coordinated hero operations
Response-condition mechanics and equipment limits respected
No family, leisure, romance or other ordinary private setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated hypothetical (a late-school ally praises him for making an enemy genuinely loyal; best-supported response is to correct the causal claim, explain the controllable action and keep monitoring the enemy's independent intent, high confidence in the distinction and medium in tone) and the probe-supported attribution policy support narrow novel scenes in trained operational settings. The probe is retrospective, nonblind and narrow, with an underdetermined emotional axis.

The model affirmatively says private family life and ordinary adult intimacy remain thin and that ordinary leisure and family conflict predictions should remain low confidence; the located social evidence is competition, training and operations.

No dilemma he weighs is analyzed; the located evidence (SI04-SI05) shows sanctioned operational use and honest causal attribution, and the model's consent and command conditions constrain a simulator rather than predicting his deliberation.
The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence. This gap says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is an authorized, coordinated hero training exercise or operation after V35, with the Brainwashing version stated.
Output preserves the response-condition mechanism, the limit on authoring motive and his monitoring of independent intent.
Adult institutional address, international cooperation work and independent career decisions are not predicted; the model samples them thinly.
scenario_readiness.note: The model calls SI-V01 a bounded validation of professional judgment: in coordinated operations he creates the response condition, applies control within its limits and attributes a target's continuing action to the target (SI04-SI05). Adult professional continuity is thin (SI06, SI-SUP-03).

known_limits.statement: Controlling behavior does not author a person's heart; post-control conduct belongs to the target (SI05, SI-SUP-02).

Brainwashing requires a response; training and equipment expand the command repertoire, but no telepathy, memory access, omnipotent persuasion or motive rewriting is licensed, and Persona Chords is vulnerable to impact.
What he knows of a target comes from observation, briefing or supplied recordings, not from control; the classmates' farewell planning was not knowledge he had.
Later compelled speech and the Machia distinction are not assigned to the festival applicant, and V42 admission is not assigned to the General Studies state.
Early provocation can be tactical bait for a response and is not his ordinary opinion of the target; early envy does not exhaust his motive.

Private family life, ordinary adult intimacy, leisure and responses outside trained role contexts are thin or OPEN in the model; no globally cynical adult or frictionless post-admission confidence is warranted.
Supplement profile facts, editorial summaries, design notes and author comments (SI-SUP-01 to SI-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.

The single formal probe SI-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; it is a narrow test of professional judgment with an underdetermined emotional axis and a partial relationship axis.
No atom covers V05-V20, V24-V34, V36-V37 or V39-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
